releases.name: v1.0.17 — Zero-setup launch, automatic server failover & docs overhaul
releases.body:
## What's new

### Zero-setup launch
No more installing Bun separately — the plugin now runs entirely on the Bun runtime bundled with OpenCode. Install the plugin, restart, and the pixel-art office window opens on its own.

### Automatic server failover
Previously, closing the instance that hosted the visualization server killed the server and froze every character. Now, surviving instances detect the disconnect and one of them automatically takes over the server role — characters keep moving without interruption.

### Last-agent cleanup
When the final OpenCode instance closes, the remaining character now walks out of the office instead of standing there forever.

### Documentation overhaul
- Removed the incorrect "install Bun" requirement
- Replaced the inaccurate "Via OpenCode UI" section with the real CLI command (`opencode plugin`)
- Added local-file / development installation path
- Added an **Updating** section with cache-clearing instructions
- Documented the auto-launch behavior and port (`5173`)

---

### Updating

```sh
opencode plugin psinetron-opencode-visualizer --force
```

If the old version persists, clear the cache:
```sh
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/packages/psinetron-opencode-visualizer
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/packages/psinetron-opencode-visualizer@latest```

Then restart OpenCode.
